description: Build release images in CI; sign hub and sensor firmware; publish images to the update service and hand them to the contract manufacturer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loss of the signing key cannot be recovered: every unit trusts only that key, so a lost key means re-keying all units and a pilot rebuild (about $60,000 and 6 weeks). Release records are design history records and must not be lost (RPO 0). A pilot build or a partner hospital evaluation waits no more than 3 business days
manual_workaround: Delay the release; no manual signing path exists. Backup key copy on the encrypted USB drive in the office safe
dependent_third_parties: Source code and CI service vendor; cloud provider; contract manufacturer
dependent_people_or_facilities: Head of Engineering (only person able to sign today); office safe

description: Keep controlled documents, requirements, design reviews, risk management file, supplier records, and training records in the eQMS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The design history file is the evidence for the 510(k) and for QMSR design controls (21 CFR 820.10(c)). Loss or corruption of approved records would force re-creation and could delay the submission
manual_workaround: Work on draft documents in the productivity suite; hold approvals until the eQMS is back; record signatures on paper forms scanned later

business_process: Premarket submission preparation and FDA correspondence
description: Assemble the 510(k), including the cybersecurity documentation (threat model, SBOM, testing, management plan); manage the pre-submission and FDA correspondence
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Each week of slip in the 2027-03-31 submission costs about $43,000 of runway. Near FDA deadlines or the submission date, 3 days is the limit. Drafts change daily, so one day of loss is the most that can be redone
manual_workaround: Work from local copies and the regulatory consultant's copies; request more time from FDA through the Q-Submission contact if a meeting date is at risk
dependent_third_parties: eQMS vendor; productivity suite vendor; regulatory consultant

description: Write and review sensor, hub, and cloud code; run CI builds and tests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Engineers can work locally for about 3 days before merges and builds block the schedule. Code is pushed several times a day, so up to one working day of unpushed local work may be lost
manual_workaround: Work on local clones; share patches by email for review; build locally on a laptop (not for release)
dependent_third_parties: Source code and CI service vendor; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Firmware Engineer; Cloud Software Engineer; Head of Engineering

description: Ingestion API, clinician dashboard, update service, and database used for verification tests and the partner hospital evaluation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supports verification runs and the simulation center evaluation; no patient uses it today. Test data can be regenerated from simulators within a day. After clearance this becomes the most critical function, with minutes-level recovery targets to be set before launch
manual_workaround: Hubs keep showing vital signs and sounding alarms locally without the cloud; reschedule verification runs

description: Run verification protocols on the 22 lab units; security testing; coordinate the third-party penetration test
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Verification records feed the submission. A week of lab downtime shifts the schedule but is recoverable. Raw test data is uploaded to the eQMS daily
manual_workaround: Run protocols that do not need the lab network; reorder the test schedule
dependent_systems: SYS-08; SYS-05 (lab workstations); SYS-06; SYS-04; SYS-02
dependent_people_or_facilities: Verification and Test Engineer; engineering lab

description: Send released firmware and the provisioning file to the contract manufacturer; supplier quality; pilot build support
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No pilot build is scheduled until 2027 Q1. A week of delay affects only engineering spares. Supplier records live in the eQMS
manual_workaround: Courier an encrypted drive with signed images; phone the contract manufacturer's program manager

business_process: Vulnerability intake and product security monitoring
description: Receive vulnerability reports from researchers, suppliers, and the partner hospital; monitor components for new vulnerabilities (planned; not yet operating)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The planned CVD policy promises acknowledgment within 3 business days. A missed report about the evaluation units could reach the partner hospital or the public first
manual_workaround: Researchers can reach the CEO through the website contact form; the partner hospital calls the Head of Engineering directly

description: Payroll, accounts payable (including contract manufacturer invoices), investor reporting, contracts, and email
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly through an outside payroll service. Invoices tolerate a week's delay
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; pay urgent invoices through the bank portal
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; bank; accounting SaaS; productivity suite vendor; MSP
